I am excited to share a few of the different things we've done with Freshservice, they were aimed at transitioning us from traditional help desk software to a more comprehensive ITSM solution.

Our goal was to bring greater value organization-wide by leveraging key Freshservice features such as asset management and change control to name a few. We minimized our ticket categories and aligned them closely with our operational systems.  During this initiative we reduced ticket outcomes and root causes, we had over a 100 hundred (we have 20 now) that traditionally clog up systems with bad data, ultimately allowing for more precise information and analytics.

One of the significant advantages of this shift is the positive impact it had on Freddy, by aiding in key problem identification and resolution (minimize outcomes led to stronger leads), Freddy can focus on addressing underlying issues more effectively, enhancing our overall efficiency.  Before Freddy would have 7-10 possible causes/fixes, now we strive to have less than 3-5. 

To measure our success:

1. Ticket Resolution Time: Tracking the average time taken to resolve tickets before and after the transition.
2. First Contact Resolution Rate: Measuring the percentage of issues resolved on the first interaction to assess improvement in customer satisfaction.
3. Change Success Rate: Monitoring the success of changes implemented to ensure they deliver value and minimize downtime.
4. Employee Satisfaction Surveys: Gathering feedback from users to evaluate their experience with the new ITSM processes.
5. Asset Utilization Rates: Analyzing the usage of assets to ensure they are being effectively managed and maximized.

Furthermore, our integration with business partners has been pivotal. Collaboration with them has ensured that our ITSM approach aligns with broader organizational objectives, ultimately creating a more cohesive strategy for service management.

Agent efficiency: By shifting common queries to self-service, we measured a reduction in the number of repetitive tickets, allowing agents to focus on more complex cases.
